posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Ali Abbas Zafar confirms superhero film series kicking off with Katrina in the lead — meanwhile she celebrated Vicky Kaushal's birthday with son Vihaan in an adorable family moment

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Paid tribute to Punjabi music legends at a sold-out Madison Square Garden show — his film Main Vaapas Aaunga drops June 12 with AR Rahman's soundtrack, plus Sardaar Ji 3 behind-the-scenes footage

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: YRF set to unveil the Alpha teaser on June 10 — the spy-action film co-starring Sharvari releases July 3 and marks Alia's entry into the YRF Spy Universe

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Confirms 6 months of shooting still pending for Rajamouli's epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu — hints at an Antarctica schedule and calls it the most ambitious project she's ever been part of

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King shoot in full swing with a ₹350 crore budget and massive ensemble cast — confirmed for a Christmas 2026 release alongside co-star Deepika Padukone

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: In talks to join Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film — also weighed in on the Peddi objectification row, calling for more thoughtful portrayal of women on screen

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha biopic release date locked for August 28, 2026 — the film based on the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar marks Shraddha's most challenging role to date

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second baby with Ranveer Singh — will use a body double for action scenes in Allu Arjun's Raka while also filming SRK's King in parallel

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 smashes ₹1800 crore worldwide — now streaming on JioHotstar from June 4, with next film Pralay set to start shooting in August 2026

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Named JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador for their new 'Stay in the Moment' luxury travel platform — announced June 7 in a major hospitality-meets-Bollywood collaboration

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: In talks for the MS Subbulakshmi biopic while Cocktail 2 tops IMDb's most-anticipated list — Ranabaali with Vijay Deverakonda is 90% shot and wrapping up

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram releasing June 19 — Samantha revealed that Sai Pallavi was the initial choice for the role before she came on board

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Shoot has begun for AA22 with director Atlee in Mumbai — the ₹600 crore mega-budget film features a dual role; also praised Ram Charan's Peddi performance

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹200 crore India gross in just 6 days — Ram Charan watched the film with fans at a packed Hyderabad theater in a viral moment

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon with Prashanth Neel locks a June 2027 release window — also teamed up with director Nelson Dilipkumar for a brand new untitled project

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: At the center of the Peddi objectification controversy — leaked chats reveal she objected to certain shots during filming, and director Buchi Babu publicly apologized

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Celebrated her early birthday on set while filming her next project — her cousin is also set to make a Bollywood debut soon, keeping the Panday family in the spotlight

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Shut down rumors about discomfort with bold scenes in Toxic — first look as Nadia unveiled to massive fan excitement; also wished director Geetu Mohandas on her birthday

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Rakesh Roshan shuts down reports of a budget clash with YRF over Krrish 4 — confirms the superhero sequel is progressing smoothly and on track

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai earns ~₹33 crore in 4 days at the box office — the film marks David Dhawan's final directorial venture, making it an emotional father-son moment

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Released devotional single 'Siddha Bhajo' as a heartfelt tribute to her late father — The Unstoppable Tour dates announced for September 2026 across US and Canada

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Made history with the first-ever live concert at the Attari-Wagah border for Main Vaapas Aaunga — performed Vande Mataram and Maa Tujhe Salaam in a goosebump moment

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Historic political debut — his party TVK swept 108 seats in the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections; his final film Jana Nayagan is on the verge of release
